_readme: NIL agency ledger: one row a player and source (scripts/agencies.py). agency = the firm a source names, "Family" when a relative handles his deals, "None" when a source says he has no agent. confidence high (agency page, announcement or named major-outlet report), medium (one outlet, older than a year or may be stale), low (indirect). Never guessed; a player no source names is left out.
